guidedTourEscHint: Press Esc to leave any time
guidedTourHint: Lost? Click this ? to replay the tours any time.
guidedTourHub_overview_sub: What Code, Work and Chats are for
guidedTourHub_chats_sub: Private and group chats, assistants, phone
guidedTour_overview_intro_body: These buttons at the top left switch between three modes: Code, Work and Chats. Take 30 seconds to meet them?
guidedTour_overview_code_body: Open a project folder and tell Kun what to change. It reads code, edits files and runs commands, and you review the changes on the right. The first visit points out its buttons.
guidedTour_overview_work_body: Work happens in a space, which is a folder. Papers, files, sessions and the slides, documents and sheets Kun makes all live there.
guidedTour_overview_chats_title: Chats: talk like you would to a bot
guidedTour_overview_chats_body: The personal-assistant bot you use in a chat app is a conversation here: message it directly on your computer, start a group, hand off tasks. It remembers you.
guidedTour_overview_newButton_title: The first button is always New
guidedTour_overview_newButton_body: New task in Code, new session in Work, new chat in Chats.
guidedTour_overview_composer_body: Say what you want done. Here you also pick who does it, which model, and whether files may be changed directly.
guidedTour_overview_help_body: It replays this tour and the tours for Code, Work and Chats.
guidedTour_overview_pick: Which mode first? Its own tour picks up once you are there.
guidedTour_code_intro_body: Describe what you want done. Kun, or a coding Agent you connected, reads code, edits files and runs commands in your project. Here are the main parts.
guidedTour_code_newTask_body: Start new work here. The magnifier next to it searches every task by title and content.
guidedTour_code_projects_body: Each project is a code folder with its tasks under it. Use ＋ to open another project folder.
guidedTour_code_where_body: Pick the project, and whether to change it in place or in a separate worktree that leaves your branch alone.
guidedTour_code_controls_title: Who does it, and how far it may go
guidedTour_code_controls_body: Pick Kun or a connected Agent such as Claude Code or Codex, and a model. Permissions decide whether it asks before editing files or running commands. ＋ holds plans, skills and plugins.
guidedTour_code_panel_body: This column opens Changes, Files, the browser preview, Plan and Collaboration. Changes shows every edited file, ready to revert or commit.
guidedTour_code_replay_body: Each one fills in the composer; nothing is sent for you. Click Code tour any time to replay this.
guidedTour_code_starterExplainPrompt: Help me get to know this project: outline the folder structure and key modules, explain how it is built and run, and list the few files you suggest I read first.
guidedTour_code_starterFixPrompt: Help me fix a problem. What happens: [describe what you see]; expected: [what should happen]; steps: [how to trigger it]. Find the cause and tell me your plan before changing anything.
guidedTour_code_starterPlan: Plan first, then build a small feature
guidedTour_code_starterPlanPrompt: I want to add a small feature: [describe it]. Read the related code first and give me a step-by-step plan; start building once I confirm.
guidedTour_work_intro_body: Write documents, read papers and make slides here. Kun set up a default space for you. Here are the main parts.
guidedTour_work_newSession_title: A new session, or straight to a document
guidedTour_work_newSession_body: New session starts a piece of work with Kun. The small icon next to it creates a document in the current space.
guidedTour_work_artifacts_body: Slides, Word files, sheets, charts and designs from every space are collected here. Open one to preview it, or ask Kun to keep editing.
guidedTour_work_space_body: New sessions, files and papers are stored in the current space. Switch spaces here, or add your own folder.
guidedTour_work_sessions_title: Sessions: work you did with Kun
guidedTour_work_sessions_body: Open one to continue; each session remembers the files it read and changed.
guidedTour_work_papers_body: The library holds papers you imported; Discover finds new ones by topic. Import a PDF, arXiv link, DOI or title, then ask questions while you read.
guidedTour_work_files_body: Click to open in the middle; Office files, PDFs and images open for viewing and editing. Drag a file into the composer and Kun answers with it.
guidedTour_work_composer_body: Say what you want to write, read or organize. ＋ adds files, skills and plugins; pick the Agent and model next to it.
guidedTour_work_rail_body: This column holds the assistant; with a document open you also get the outline, review (Kun's suggested edits) and references. Papers appear when a search finds some.
guidedTour_work_help_body: These only open something or fill in the composer; nothing is sent. Click the ? at the bottom left to replay.
guidedTour_work_starterReportSub: Give Kun the points, get a draft
guidedTour_work_starterReportPrompt: Write this week's report for me. Done this week: [a few points]; next week: [a few points]. Bullet points, one page at most.
guidedTour_chats_intro_body: Chat privately or in groups with Kun and other Agents. The personal-assistant bot you use in a chat app works right here on your computer.
guidedTour_chats_list_body: Private chats, groups and personal assistants, newest first. A dot on Chats at the top means a new message or a question waiting for you.
guidedTour_chats_newChat_title: Start a chat, or connect an assistant
guidedTour_chats_newChat_body: Pick one Agent for a private chat, or several for a group. “Connect a personal assistant” in this menu brings in the assistant you already use, to hand tasks off like a bot.
guidedTour_chats_stage_body: Say what you need. It remembers your habits and sends reminders on time; charts, documents and slides it makes appear as cards in the chat.
guidedTour_chats_phone_title: Reach it from your phone too
guidedTour_chats_phone_body: This connects the same assistant to chat apps such as Lark or WeChat. Message it on the go, then continue here at your desk.
guidedTour_chats_bot_title: Chats is your personal assistant, local
guidedTour_chats_bot_body: The same thing as a bot in your chat app, with a bit more:
guidedTour_chats_compareBot: A bot in a chat app
guidedTour_chats_compare_talk_local: Message it directly, drop files in
guidedTour_chats_compare_memory_local: The same memory, visible and editable
guidedTour_chats_compare_schedule_local: The same, with results in this chat
guidedTour_chats_compare_results_local: Charts, documents and slides open in the chat
